claim: Formby (National Trust) car parks at Lifeboat Road and Victoria Road open 09:00-17:00, parking £9 (free for NT members and blue badge); beach is open all day; dogs welcome.
quote: Beaches: Open all day | Lifeboat Road car park: 09:00 - 17:00 | Victoria Road car park: 09:00 - 17:00 ... Car parking costs £9.00 ... Free parking for National Trust members ... Dogs are welcome at Formby

claim: Formby's pinewoods host red squirrels; the wider site features sand dunes with natterjack toads, prehistoric footprints and shipwrecks on the beach, plus a 1.75-mile Asparagus Trail.
quote: Some of Europe's best sand dune habitats, where many rare species, including natterjack toads, thrive ... shipwrecks ... prehistoric footprints ... A 1.75-mile walking route that explores the history of Asparagus at Formby

claim: Crosby Beach's 'Another Place' is best visited with the tide times in mind; the nearest car parks are at Hall Road (L23 8SY), Mariners Road and Cambridge Road, and Merseyrail runs trains every ~15 minutes to Hall Road/Blundellsands/Waterloo.
quote: Before visiting the beach, please familiarise yourself with the tide times ... Hall Road, Blundellsands (L23 8SY) - closest to Another Place ... Trains run approximately every 15 minutes

claim: Crosby Coastal Park surrounds the Gormley sculptures with a marine lake, formal gardens, playground and the start of the 22-mile Sefton Coastal Path, with strong bird life and watersports.
quote: The 22 mile Sefton Coastal path starts here and a section of the national cycle path network runs the length of the Park ... large marine lake popular for water sports, formal gardens, amenity grasslands and a children's playground

claim: Ainsdale & Birkdale Sandhills (988 ha) is one of Britain's largest wild dune areas, famous for natterjack toads ('Birkdale Nightingale'), sand lizards and great crested newts; parking at Ainsdale Discovery Centre.
quote: one of the largest areas of wild dune land left in Britain ... ideal breeding pools for Natterjack Toads, whose astonishing chorus earns it the local name of 'Birkdale Nightingale' ... A car park is available at Ainsdale Discovery Centre

claim: Ainsdale Sand Dunes NNR has ~8 miles of way-marked footpaths; the Woodland Path and Fisherman's Path are wheelchair/pushchair/cycle accessible; reachable on foot from Ainsdale or Freshfield rail stations.
quote: The reserve has a network of around 8 miles of footpaths marked with colour-topped posts. The Woodland Path and Fisherman's Path are accessible by bike, pushchairs and wheelchairs

claim: Mere Sands Wood (Rufford) is a 42-ha Lancashire Wildlife Trust reserve with six accessible hides, 170+ recorded bird species, red squirrels and ~95% wheelchair-accessible paths; visitor centre/cafe open Wed-Sun 10:00-16:00; £4 car park.
quote: Visitor centre and cafe: Wednesday - Sunday, 10am - 4pm ... 42 hectares in size ... 95% of paths wheelchair/pram accessible ... six accessible hides

claim: WWT Martin Mere (Burscough, ~10 km from Aughton) opens 09:30-18:00 in summer (last entry 17:00) with free on-site parking; activities include canoe safaris, pond dipping and adventure play.
quote: The centre is open 9.30am to 6pm (last entry 5pm) ... The gift shop is open 9:30am until 5:30pm

claim: Beacon Country Park (Up Holland) covers 300+ acres of meadow, woodland and ponds with free parking, café, orienteering course and a Tramper off-road mobility scooter for hire.
quote: over 300 acres of rolling countryside ... flowing wildflower meadows, grassland, natural ponds and areas of semi-natural woodland ... off-road mobility scooter (Tramper) available for hire

claim: Croxteth Country Park has a free car park (locked overnight) and includes Croxteth Home Farm with rare breeds, a miniature railway, parkrun routes and Grade II* Croxteth Hall.
quote: Free car park off Muirhead Avenue East/Oak Lane ... Croxteth Hall, a Grade II* listed stately home, is the historic seat of the Molyneux family ... Croxteth Home Farm (rare breed animals, historic farming) ... Miniature railway

claim: Rivington Terraced Gardens / Lever Park (borderline ~30 km east) offer four free car parks (Lower House nearest to the gardens, ~80 cars), with on-site cafés including Great House Barn and The Café at Spring Cottage.
quote: Lower House Car park ... can hold up to 80 cars and is the nearest one to the Terraced Gardens ... Parking is free but visitors are requested to pay a small donation

claim: Mere Sands Wood car park is open 24 hours with a £4 charge; payment by cash (coins), card, contactless or RingGo code 25807.
quote: The car park is open 24 hours a day, with a £4 charge ... the RingGo app code for Mere Sands Wood is 25807
